model: Single electromagnetic vacuum in a flat static cube with six perfectly conducting faces, zero temperature; local center only
normalization: rho_center=q*hbar*c/L^4; L is the cube side; imaginary time regulator tau is measured in L/c
subtraction: Point-split local field-strength correlations minus the Minkowski bulk singularity 3/(pi^2*tau^4); no global-energy/V substitution or subtraction of finite edge images
image_kernel: For m in Z^3 except zero, s_i=(-1)^m_i, S=product(s_i), r=|m|: f=(1+S)/(2*pi^2)*[-sum(s_i)/r^4+2*sum(s_i*m_i^2)/r^6]
image_basis: A0 Dirichlet on every face; Ai Neumann on its normal faces and Dirichlet on the others. Covariant image propagator D00=-S*G, Dii=S*s_i*G, G=[4*pi^2*(r^2-(dt-i0)^2)]^-1; differentiate to E and B correlations
resummation: q=-Z3(2)/(16*pi^2)-(3*pi/8)*sum_{p,q odd}[coth(pi*r/2)*csch(pi*r/2)^2/r], r=sqrt(p^2+q^2); both contributions strictly negative

bounds.ewald: theta^3-theta_N^3<=8*exp[-pi*(N+1)^2*t] for t>=1; integrate the positive theta-split kernel
bounds.regulator_series: With u=tau^2/4<1, translation=-sum_k (-1)^k*(k+1)*(2*k+1)*u^k*Z3(k+2)/(16*pi^2); polynomial-geometric tail uses Z3(k+2)<=13*pi^2/3
bounds.modes: For cutoff N, omitted positive mode energy<=14*pi*sqrt(3)*sum_{m=N+1}^infinity m^3*exp[-pi*tau*m]
bounds.rounding: Analytic tail bounds exclude arithmetic rounding. Ewald special functions use60 decimal digits, other image arithmetic50, mode sums float64; no interval certification

exact_checks.right_angle_wedge: rho=-hbar*c/(16*pi^2*r^4): exact match to published wedge formula at angle pi/2
exact_checks.center_tensor: Static vacuum reflections kill flux and off-diagonal stress; cubic symmetry and zero bulk Maxwell trace give p_i=rho/3
exact_checks.isotropy_scope: Finite symmetric image sums are exactly isotropic; absolute convergence preserves the identities in their limit

coherent_center.convention: Contravariant orthonormal stress, signature -+++; hbar=c=cube side=1; center at x=y=z=1/2, reference time t0
coherent_center.mode_definition: f_i=a_i*cos(pi*n_i*x_i)*product_{j!=i}sin(pi*n_j*x_j); A_field=sum Q_lambda*f_lambda, E=-sum P_lambda*f_lambda, B=sum Q_lambda*curl(f_lambda)
coherent_center.exact_checks: Six divergence, vector Helmholtz, unit spatial norm, tangential f and normal curl on all six faces, center values, four null tensors and mixture equality passed
coherent_center.classical_initial_data: For any prescribed center E,B: electric-mode P_i=-E_i/2, Q_i=0; magnetic-mode Q_i=B_i/(8*pi), P_i=0. Finite smooth modes solve source-free Maxwell equations and the conducting boundary conditions
coherent_center.quantum_state: Use alpha_lambda=(sqrt(omega_lambda)*Q_lambda+i*P_lambda/sqrt(omega_lambda))/sqrt(2) to displace the same cavity vacuum. D^dagger*F*D=F+F_classical gives <T>_alpha,ren=<T>_vac,ren+T[F_classical]; the finite displacement leaves the ultraviolet singularity unchanged
coherent_center.mixed_state: density=(1/4)*sum_j |alpha_j><alpha_j|. Choose E_j=sqrt(3*A)*ey for the first two directions, sqrt(3*A)*ex for the other two; B_j=n_j cross E_j. Linearity of a probabilistic mixture removes inter-state interference; this is not a coherent superposition of the four states
coherent_center.match: At A=-rho_vac/4=-q/4>0, vacuum=diag(-4*A,-4*A/3,-4*A/3,-4*A/3); mixture gives exactly -A*ell^a*ell^b for ell=(1,0,0,1), at one event

witness_evolution.time: Real evolution time tau=c*(t-t0)/L, distinct from the imaginary-time regulator
witness_evolution.no_exact_nonzero_recurrence: rho/A=-1 requires both cosines squared=1, hence sqrt(2)*tau and 3*tau integers. Irrational sqrt(2)/3 permits only tau=0. This applies to this six-mode witness and this fixed target amplitude, not every cavity state or an approximate tolerance

stationary_center_audit.identity: n_i=2*k_i+b_i implies |n|^2=sum(b_i)+4*sum(k_i*(k_i+b_i)); all eight bit patterns checked exactly
stationary_center_audit.disjoint_spectra: Nonzero center E requires two odd indices, so |n|^2=2 mod4; nonzero center B requires one odd index, so |n|^2=1 mod4. Their frequencies cannot coincide
stationary_center_audit.argument: For a stationary density operator commuting with the free cavity Hamiltonian, expectation(a_lambda^dagger*a_mu)=0 unless omega_lambda=omega_mu, while expectation(a_lambda*a_mu)=0 because every physical frequency is positive. The aa^dagger commutator term is diagonal in the mode and no mode contributes both center E and B. Thus every symmetrized center E-B correlation is zero, including temporal point splitting; its Minkowski subtraction is also zero, so all T0i(center)=0
stationary_center_audit.conclusion: No stationary state with defined renormalized stress in this free empty lossless closed ideal cube can supply the target nonzero center flux, even if the state breaks spatial symmetry. The nonstationary one-event mixed coherent state is allowed
stationary_center_audit.scope: External drives, ports, changed shape, realistic walls or curved geometry change the hypotheses. This supplies no universal finite-duration or beat-time bound: higher-frequency gaps can approach zero

rectangular_resonance.convention: Contravariant orthonormal added EM stress, signature -+++; hbar=c=1; physical side lengths (1,1,sqrt(10)/4)
rectangular_resonance.general_resonance: For nE=(2,1,3), nB=(2,3,2), omegaE^2-omegaB^2=pi^2*(5/Lz^2-8/Ly^2); Lz^2=5*Ly^2/8 removes the difference for any Lx>0
rectangular_resonance.stationary_quantum_state: Displace the SAME rectangular-cavity vacuum with these two finite mode coordinates and momenta, alpha_j=(sqrt(omega)*q_j+i*p_j/sqrt(omega))/sqrt(2). Uniformly mix theta over0..2*pi. Equal frequencies make free evolution a common theta shift, leaving this density operator invariant; no external drive is introduced. Normal coherence between the degenerate modes survives phase averaging
rectangular_resonance.renormalization: For each coherent component the renormalized stress is rectangular-vacuum stress plus its classical stress. The finite displacement leaves the ultraviolet singularity unchanged; averaging the density operator averages the classical tensor
rectangular_resonance.positive_null_case: E0=B0 gives added tensor=(E0^2/2)*ell_plus*ell_plus, ell_plus=(1,0,0,1). B0=-E0 reverses flux while preserving positive energy; both identities checked exactly
rectangular_resonance.excitation_energy_formula: V*(5*E0^2+(97/52)*B0^2)/16, finite for finite E0,B0; mean added photon number=excitation_energy/omega
rectangular_resonance.wall_flux: Normal E cross B is identically zero on all six PEC faces, checked for the full two-mode solution. Nonzero center flux does not imply net transport through the closed walls
rectangular_resonance.exact_checks: Unit polarizations, transversality, both vector Helmholtz equations, unit norms and mutual orthogonality, six-face PEC conditions, center fields, all16 averaged tensor components, zero trace, both null directions, conserved finite excitation and zero wall-normal flux

conditional_compensation.assumptions: Conditional vacuum tensor diag(-D,p,p,-D-2p), D>0, p<0, D+p>0; no numerical rectangular vacuum value is asserted or borrowed from the cube
conditional_compensation.added_weights: w_minus=(D+p)/2, w_plus=(D+p)/2-A; both nonnegative on the stated interval. For each resonant family set E0=sqrt(2*w), B0=+/-sqrt(2*w) for the corresponding flux direction

extra_mode.exact_checks: Unit norm, orthogonality to both resonant modes, divergence, Helmholtz, all six PEC faces, center fields, phase-averaged stress and conserved finite excitation

conditional_compensation.state: Integrate |alpha_minus(theta_minus)+alpha_plus(theta_plus)+alpha_z(theta_z)><same| against the product of three uniform phase measures. All amplitudes belong to the SAME cavity mode space; the +/- families share the two resonant modes. This is a mixture of coherent states of summed amplitudes, explicitly not a Hilbert-space tensor product for those families
conditional_compensation.stationarity: Each coherent family evolves by its phase shift; the joint uniform measure is invariant under free evolution. Zero first phase moments remove cross terms. The full center stress EXPECTATION is stationary at all times; individual coherent realizations need not have a stationary tensor. No drive or independent electromagnetic field is introduced
conditional_compensation.finite_excitation: Each ray family has mean energy357*V*w/416 and the extra mode has energy -V*p/2. Their sum is finite and positive under the stated assumptions; all three physical mode frequencies are finite and positive

necessity.class_of_states: Arbitrary positive mixtures of coherent displacements of this fixed vacuum, with finite classical second moments
necessity.inequality: Let X=(Ex,Bx), Y=(By,-Ey). Cauchy-Schwarz in the classical ensemble gives A^2=<X dot Y>^2<=Cx*Cy=(D-A+p)^2. Since Cx>=0, 2*A<=D+p
necessity.factorization: (D-A+p)^2-A^2=(D+p)*(D+p-2*A), checked exactly; the construction attains A=(D+p)/2
necessity.exclusions: Not a bound for arbitrary squeezed or other nonclassical states: their vacuum-subtracted additions need not be positive classical second moments

conditional_compensation.previous_bound: D/4 was the null-beam-only compensation bound for the isotropic cube vacuum. The extra positive-energy electric mode supplies longitudinal Maxwell tension, so that bound does not restrict this broader coherent-mixture class. Formal isotropic input p=-D/3 gives D/3 here, but the actual cube retains its separate stationary parity obstruction

rectangle_vacuum.model: Zero-temperature vacuum of one free EM field in a flat static conducting rectangle; local center only
rectangle_vacuum.normalization: Lx=Ly=L, Lz=sqrt(5/8)*L; reported stress coefficients multiply hbar*c/L^4. tau is imaginary-time separation in units L/c

conditional_compensation_numeric_link.relation: Amax=(D+p)/2 for the separately checked rectangular_resonance.conditional_compensation coherent-mixture theorem; coefficient multiplies hbar*c/L^4 and applies at the center only

rectangle_vacuum.image_kernel: d_i=m_i*Li, s_i=(-1)^m_i, S=product(s_i), U=sum(d_i^2)+tau^2: C_i=sum_{m!=0}(1+S)*s_i/pi^2*(-1/U^2+2*(d_i^2+tau^2)/U^3); rho=sum(C_i)/2, p_i=rho-C_i
rectangle_vacuum.theta_definition: theta_b(v)=sum_n(-1)^(b*n)*exp(-pi*v*n^2); Theta_b(u)=product_j theta_bj(u*Lj^2); M_i,b=sum_m m_i^2*(-1)^(b dot m)*exp(-pi*u*sum_j Lj^2*m_j^2)
rectangle_vacuum.theta_integral: S_i=Theta_ei+Theta_(1-ei)-2, Q_i=M_i,ei+M_i,(1-ei). C_i(tau)=integral_0^infinity exp(-pi*u*tau^2)*[u*(pi*u*tau^2-1)*S_i+pi*u^2*Li^2*Q_i] du. The -2 removes only the zero Minkowski image
rectangle_vacuum.modular_identity: For v<1, theta_b(v)=v^(-1/2)*sum_n exp[-pi*(n+b/2)^2/v]; its n^2 moment is S0/(2*pi*v^(3/2))-S2/v^(5/2). Direct signed Gaussian sums are used for v>=1
rectangle_vacuum.physical_mode_weights: R^2=sum_i(n_i/Li)^2, omega=pi*sqrt(R^2), V=product(Li), n_i>=0 with at most one zero. For mixed parity j is the unique odd or unique even index; W_rho=2*omega/V*(1-(n_j/Lj)^2/R^2)*2^(-zero_count). Only C_j=2*W_rho is nonzero. Multiply by exp(-tau*omega); other parities vanish
rectangle_vacuum.mode_subtraction: Subtract 3/(pi^2*tau^4) from rho and 2/(pi^2*tau^4) from each C_i; compute each pressure as rho-C_i

precision.mode_tail: Max-index shell m has <=7*m^2 modes and W_rho<=2*pi*sqrt(3)*m/(V*Lmin). Each mode has only C_j=2*W_rho, so every pressure is +/-W_rho; the positive density tail also bounds each absolute pressure tail. This fixed aspect has Lmax=1
precision.scope: Quadrature estimates and refinement evidence are not interval certification. Mode sums are float64; analytic mode tails exclude arithmetic rounding. The direct/modular theta split avoids the algebraic edge tail

separate_edge_sign_audit.derivation: For an odd pair, |C_i term|<=F(x)/(pi*h*a^3), F=coth(x)+x*csch(x)^2+x^2*coth(x)*csch(x)^2. F decreases for x>=1 and F(10)<1.001; omitted x>3108. Odd max-norm shells have 4*k points, giving sum_tail r^-3<=2/(M+1). Sum all three pair bounds; omitted rho is negative, so p_tail<=|C_i tail|
separate_edge_sign_audit.scope: Partial pressure is from the separately reported M2501 audit; its large finite sum is not rerun here. This analytic tail upper bound does not certify arithmetic rounding

temporal_density_noise.model: Final threshold state of the ideal rectangle, A=(D+p)/2; one common phase for Ex/By and an independent Ez phase
temporal_density_noise.observable: rho_f = integral dt f_sigma(t)*T00(t,center), f_sigma=exp(-t^2/(2*sigma^2))/(sqrt(2*pi)*sigma); sigma in L/c, rho in hbar*c/L^4, variance in (hbar*c/L^4)^2
temporal_density_noise.renormalization: Subtract the same cavity-vacuum c-number mean; this does not change variance. No replacement by photon-number variance or normal-ordering away of vacuum noise
temporal_density_noise.mode_convention: F=(Ex,Ey,Ez,Bx,By,Bz). Each physical center mode has one nonzero channel; W_cc(dt)=sum_omega w_c(omega)*exp(-i*omega*dt), all off-diagonal vacuum correlations vanish
temporal_density_noise.spectrum: lambda=5*nx^2+5*ny^2+8*nz^2, omega=pi*sqrt(lambda/5); w=4*omega/V*(1-kj^2/k^2)*2^(-zero_count). Unique even parity gives an E channel; unique odd gives a B channel. Polarizations are summed by the transverse projector
temporal_density_noise.vacuum_formula: Var0=1/2*sum_c,omega,nu w_c(omega)*w_c(nu)*exp[-sigma^2*(omega+nu)^2]. Ordered pairs include equal modes. Wick contraction is W_ab^2, not absolute(W_ab)^2
temporal_density_noise.general_mode_formula: 1/2*sum_mn absolute(v_m^T*v_n)^2*absolute(f_tilde(omega_m+omega_n))^2; ordinary transpose inside the modulus, not a dagger. v=(i*sqrt(omega/2)*u,curl(u)/sqrt(2*omega))
temporal_density_noise.phase_formula: A^2/2*exp(-4*sigma^2*Omega^2)+p^2/2*exp(-4*sigma^2*Omega_z^2); law of total variance, with independent uniform phases
temporal_density_noise.total_variance: vacuum + displaced_linear + classical_phase; all contributions nonnegative

shell_weights.exact: w_Ex(97)=308*Omega/(97V), w_By(97)=208*Omega/(97V), w_Ez(10)=2*Omega_z/V, independently enumerated; unused degenerate polarizations remain in the vacuum noise

gaussian_long_time_limit.reason: The resonant difference-frequency terms remain1 for every sigma; all other terms are nonnegative. This is both a Gaussian-width-independent lower bound and the sigma->infinity limit

general_normalized_sampling_bound.assumptions: Any real normalized temporal sampling g with integral(g)=1 and a well-defined finite second moment, for this exact stationary state and center. Normalization alone does not ensure finite variance
general_normalized_sampling_bound.argument: Replace each Gaussian kernel by absolute(g_tilde(frequency))^2. Independent phases eliminate cross terms. All coefficients are nonnegative; the resonant difference-frequency terms contain absolute(g_tilde(0))^2=1 and supply the stated bound, including signed, asymmetric or time-shifted samplings
general_normalized_sampling_bound.scope: This state and center-density observable only; not every quantum source or a gravitational stability theorem

mode_tail.vacuum_bound: (sum_tail w*exp(-sigma^2*omega^2))*(sum_all w*exp(-sigma^2*omega^2)); integral/maximum bounds on m^3*exp(-a*m^2)
mode_tail.linear_bound: 2*(A-p)*K*integral_N^infinity m^3*exp[-a*(m-sqrt(97/5))^2] dm; integrand decreasing beyond N
mode_tail.scope: Bounds cover the omitted physical modes, not floating-point roundoff or uncertainty in the ideal-wall model. Finite sums use float64; positive-tail expressions use50-digit mpmath. At wide sampling widths, positive exponentially small vacuum/phase terms can underflow to numerical zero; they are not exactly zero at finite width

This is a declared center-reference diagnostic, not the actual spatially varying curved Ori target, an invariant tensor norm, or a gravitational solution
spatial_source.bracket_scope: Each listed adjacent sample pair brackets at least one crossing of the 1% componentwise diagnostic by continuity. No interpolated location, uniqueness, monotonicity, or three-dimensional ball is inferred from axis samples
spatial_source.image_geometry: eps_i=+/-1, S=product(eps_i), d_i=(1-eps_i)*x_i-2*Li*n_i, U=sum(d_i^2)+tau^2. Exclude only the zero translation image. Single/triple reflections cancel; keep translations and the three double-reflection families
spatial_source.full_image_bilinear: Cii=sum(1+S)*eps_i/pi^2*(-1/U^2+2*(d_i^2+tau^2)/U^3); Cij=sum(1+S)*(eps_i+eps_j)*d_i*d_j/(pi^2*U^3) for i!=j. rho=trace(C)/2, Tij=rho*deltaij-Cij; physical static-vacuum T0i=0
spatial_source.shifted_theta: theta(v,beta)=sum_n exp[-pi*v*(n-beta)^2], v=4*Li^2*u and beta=x_i/Li for a reflected coordinate, otherwise0. Direct shifted Gaussians for v>=1; Poisson form v^(-1/2)*[1+2*sum_n>=1 exp(-pi*n^2/v)*cos(2*pi*n*beta)] for v<1. Differentiate to obtain first/second moments before the Laplace integrals
spatial_source.physical_modes: No center parity reduction: vi=cos(ki*xi)*prod_{j!=i}sin(kj*xj), wi=sin(ki*xi)*prod_{j!=i}cos(kj*xj), Pij=deltaij-ki*kj/omega^2. Cij_mode=(4*omega/V)*2^(-zero_count)*Pij*(vi*vj+wi*wj)*exp(-tau*omega), for physical all-positive and one-zero modes

noncenter_finite_tau_check.scope: Imaginary-time split for checking energy and every spatial stress component; not real-time evolution. Subtract Minkowski Cii=2/(pi^2*tau^4). The positive mode-energy tail bounds every spatial stress entry; it excludes arithmetic rounding
